headline: Financials Lead a Split Tape as Rate Worries Hang Over the Session
body_html:
The market is divided at midday, with 320 of the 664 stocks we track higher and 340 lower. These prices are preliminary and may change before the close. Financials are doing the heavy lifting, up 2.37%, well ahead of Consumer at 0.64% and Homebuilders at 0.54%. Software and Healthcare are modestly positive.

The dominant theme is interest rates. Reports suggest Fed officials are leaning toward another increase in December, and mortgage demand has softened as borrowing costs hit a three-week high. Even so, housing-linked shares are holding gains. Materials, down 1.27%, and Energy, down 1.2%, are the weakest groups, and Semiconductors are off 0.48%. Gold miners are a notable drag, with Agnico Eagle down 6.67% and DRDGOLD down 6.45%.

The standout mover is Vital Farms, up 12.33%, while TJX Companies has gained 7.55%. On the downside, Applied Optoelectronics has fallen 14.61%. Into the close, watch whether financials keep their lead and whether rate-sensitive groups hold steady ahead of Thursday, November 19.

briefs.headline: TJX Surges as Retail Draws Buyers
briefs.body: TJX Companies is up 7.55% in the retail group's strongest showing of the morning. Consumer shares as a whole are higher by 0.64%. Separately, Lowe's reported solid online sales and lifted its outlook, even as the housing market remains sluggish.

briefs.headline: Gold Miners Slide Together
briefs.body: Agnico Eagle is down 6.67% and DRDGOLD is off 6.45%, making gold producers among the session's weakest names. Alpha Metallurgical Resources, a coal producer, is also lower, down 4.46%. The broader Materials group is down 1.27%.

briefs.headline: Mortgage Demand Cools as Rates Climb
briefs.body: Applications for home loans turned lower as mortgage rates rose to their highest level in three weeks. Reports that Fed officials may raise rates again in December add to the pressure. Homebuilder shares are still up 0.54% so far today.

briefs.headline: Optical and Diagnostics Names Hit Hard
briefs.body: Applied Optoelectronics is the worst performer in our tracked universe, down 14.61%. BillionToOne, a diagnostics company, has dropped 10.46%. Global-E Online has also fallen, down 7.75%, a reminder that stock-specific selling is running alongside the sector rotation.

briefs.headline: Hormuz Vessel Attack Keeps Geopolitics in View
briefs.body: The UAE's ADNOC L&S said one crew member is missing after an attack on one of its vessels in the Strait of Hormuz. Energy shares are down 1.2% in early trading, so traders are not bidding up the sector on the news.

briefs.headline: Retail Investors Eye a Possible Anthropic IPO
briefs.body: Individual investors are showing strong interest in a potential Anthropic public offering, with enthusiasm said to rival that around SpaceX's debut. Meanwhile, investing professionals are advising clients on how to adjust their strategies if the AI trade loses momentum.
